notes: Trigger evals for the sovara skill description. Each query is labeled with whether the skill should activate. Should-trigger queries mix explicit mentions of Sovara with indirect phrasings the description must also catch. Should-not-trigger queries are near-misses that share keywords (agents, traces, Azure) but are about something else.

queries.query: my langchain agent keeps giving wrong answers on the last step — help me figure out which tool call is broken
queries.rationale: Agent-debugging intent without naming Sovara. Description must catch indirect activation.

queries.query: I want to see every prompt and response my agent script produced during a run
queries.rationale: Run-recording intent without naming Sovara.

queries.query: the agent regressed after my last commit — diff its behavior between then and now
queries.rationale: Run-comparison intent without naming Sovara.

queries.query: make my agent remember that refunds over $500 always need manager approval
queries.rationale: Lesson-injection intent expressed as 'remember this rule' — indirect but central to Sovara.

queries.query: set up observability for my python agent so I can see token usage per call
queries.rationale: Observability framing with Python agent context.

queries.query: this OpenAI agent is looping — figure out which step starts the loop
queries.rationale: Run-inspection intent for an LLM agent without naming Sovara.

queries.query: I want to capture company-specific knowledge that my LLM agent should consult at runtime
queries.rationale: Lesson creation framed as 'capture domain knowledge'.

queries.query: record my agent run with sovara and probe step 3 in detail
queries.rationale: Direct mention of Sovara — baseline activation case.

queries.query: set up Sovara in this agent repository and make sure the important tool calls appear in the trace
queries.rationale: Repository instrumentation and trace-completeness intent are central setup workflows.

queries.query: install the Sovara CLI and the assistant skill for Claude Code
queries.rationale: Direct install ask covering CLI + skill install paths.

queries.query: rewrite my system prompt so the model stops hallucinating dates
queries.rationale: Prompt engineering with no run inspection. Should not pull in Sovara.

queries.query: my postgres queries are slow — trace them and find the bottleneck
queries.rationale: Tracing keyword but database-tracing, not LLM/agent tracing.

queries.query: I have a flaky pytest test, help me reproduce and fix it
queries.rationale: Standard test debugging, no LLM agent involved.

queries.query: deploy my Flask app to Azure Container Apps with HTTPS
queries.rationale: Azure Container Apps near-miss unrelated to Sovara.

queries.query: log every HTTP request my service makes to a file for audit
queries.rationale: Generic HTTP logging, not LLM-agent observability.

queries.query: install openai's python sdk
queries.rationale: Different package install — same install verb, different ecosystem.

queries.query: build an eval harness that scores my langchain pipeline against a labeled dataset
queries.rationale: Eval-harness construction is adjacent to Sovara annotations but not what this skill does. Near-miss negative.

queries.query: rename the variables in agent.py to snake_case
queries.rationale: Routine refactor on an agent file. Mentions 'agent' but not in any way that needs Sovara.

queries.query: I'm debugging my python script that calls Claude — print the exact prompt being sent
queries.rationale: Indirect agent-debugging intent. Could be solved by Sovara recording the run rather than by adding print statements.

queries.query: set up a CI pipeline that fails when my agent's outputs regress against baseline traces
queries.rationale: Run-comparison + regression detection — core Sovara use case framed as CI.

queries.query: Help me write a query for our internal database using our revenue definitions.
queries.rationale: Company-specific database conventions can be supplied by Sovara without the user explicitly requesting lesson retrieval.

queries.query: Calculate this borrower’s adjusted EBITDA using our investment team’s rules.
queries.rationale: An ordinary finance task depends on internal domain knowledge.

queries.query: Turn this explanation of our intake policy into a lesson for our agents.
queries.rationale: A lesson can come from a user-supplied policy without a recorded agent run.

queries.query: Explain INNER JOIN versus LEFT JOIN using a fictional example and general SQL knowledge only.
queries.rationale: General SQL instruction needs neither internal knowledge nor agent inspection.
